checks.description: AttackBuild no longer asks for a second barracks or vehicle factory, because a second one never produces: QueueFor/OwnsQueue hand every Produce to the group's first building. Last fight peaked at 4 unit factories (2 hand, 2 afld); the second afld (454s) and hand (526s) made 324 and 252 evaluations, all Continue, and delivered nothing. A replacement for a dead factory is built only after the first is gone, so the peak stays at 2.

The gap this round targets and the only fitness component short of 1.0 last fight: mean army 4,951 against 6,000, score 0.825. The 2,500 credits the dead factories cost fell in 454-590s, when cash read 0 at 500-520s and 560s and both producing queues had gaps. Spent on units instead, that is about 2,500 more army from about 500s. Diagnostic: dominated by the opponent and match length.

Last fight spent 51s in low power across three windows: 206-225s (first afld), 367-386s (hq) and 476-486s, which started once the second afld's 40 power had cut the margin to 15. Without it the third window should not happen. Diagnostic: faction and build timing move the other two windows.

The fifth refinery now follows tech and the fifth plant directly, with no factories ahead of it (last fight it stood at 569s behind both). The fleet must not shrink: last fight peaked at 9 harvesters against the opponent's 5.
Losing the spare factories must not weaken the push. Last fight destroyed 17 enemy buildings; 8 is the fitness reference.
No fight may run past the benchmark's 2,400s limit. A timed-out benchmark game voids its pair, and three voided pairs stop training.
